description: BUSQUETS, SÍLVIA and co-authors publishes raw measurements and calibration data from a combined-sewer-overflow test rig through Co-UDlabs. The USFD-08-RTCRIG project evaluates level-sensing methods and advanced computational simulations for estimating CSO flow. Separate archives contain experimental and calibration files, accompanied by apparatus and storage reports. Coverage is the University of Sheffield RTC rig; campaign dates, sensor layout and sampling interval are not specified. Zenodo provides experimental and calibration ZIP archives with descriptive PDFs with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is the short description does not identify the simulation code or report a performance comparison, and archive names alone do not establish complete calibration coverage. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
